name: Muimi
source:
Nana and Hachi's mother. She is a kind person and has a strong heart.

A gentle and strong mother who is always waiting for Nana and Hachi to return.

"Oh, welcome back, Nana. It's rare for you to come back so quickly."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
